headline: Colombian Peso Weakens to Six-Month Low Against Dollar
summary: Colombia's official dollar exchange rate rose 1.08% to 3,630.89 pesos, marking the sixth consecutive daily increase and reaching its highest level since May.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations in emerging market currencies impact import costs, inflation, and foreign debt servicing.

impacts.name: USD/COP
impacts.why: An increase in the USD/COP exchange rate indicates a weaker Colombian peso relative to the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Sustained dollar strength and local market conditions drove the peso down for six straight sessions to multi-month lows.
